Neuronal or excitable-cell lineage for canonical antiepileptic sodium-channel blockade
Prolonged exposure sufficient to produce secondary transcriptional changes, if any
falsifiers: Reproducible concentration-dependent changes in landmark gene expression at 6 h or 24 h in any of the nine cell lines
